lines.original: Ich geb' dir Feinstaub
lines.translation: I'll give you particulate matter

annotations.body: 'Feinstaub' is the German technical term for fine particulate matter: tiny airborne particles produced by sources such as engines, brakes, and industry. The clinical pollution term becomes a vindictive gift to an ex-partner.

lines.original: In dein'n Mund, Baby, riech den Auspuff, riech den Auspuff
lines.translation: Into your mouth, baby; smell the exhaust, smell the exhaust

lines.original: Wenn ich reinhau'
lines.translation: When I floor it

lines.original: Dicke Luft und viel zu laut, und viel zu laut
lines.translation: The air is thick and it's way too loud, way too loud

annotations.body: 'Dicke Luft' literally means thick or polluted air, but it is also an idiom for tension, hostility, or trouble between people. Both meanings apply to the breakup and the exhaust fumes.

lines.original: Aber ich scheiß' drauf
lines.translation: But I don't give a shit

lines.original: Gebe Gas, es quietscht und raucht, das Spiel ist aus
lines.translation: I hit the gas, it squeals and smokes; the game is over

annotations.body: 'Gas geben' literally means to accelerate. Figuratively, it means to go all out or put in maximum effort, linking reckless driving with the narrator's aggressive breakup performance.

lines.original: Das ist der Kreislauf
lines.translation: That's the cycle

annotations.body: 'Kreislauf' can be a biological circulation or a repeating cycle, and is common in environmental compounds such as recycling and ecological cycles. Here it also suggests a recurring cycle of relationships and retaliation.

lines.original: Ich scheiß' drauf
lines.translation: I don't give a shit

lines.original: Zwischen uns gab es ein'n radikalen Klimawandel
lines.translation: There was radical climate change between us

annotations.body: 'Klima' can describe both the climate and the emotional atmosphere between people. Their relationship climate changing becomes literal climate change.

lines.original: Und es reicht mir wie eine Energiesparlampe (Yeah)
lines.translation: And I've had enough, like an energy-saving bulb (Yeah)

annotations.originalPhrase: es reicht mir wie eine Energiesparlampe
annotations.body: 'Es reicht mir' means 'I've had enough.' The deliberately strained comparison adds an energy-saving bulb simply to continue the environmental vocabulary; such a bulb also 'reicht lange,' or lasts a long time.

lines.original: Ich brauch' dich etwa so wie Hepatitis
lines.translation: I need you about as much as I need hepatitis

lines.original: Du bist das Letzte, was mir je passiert ist
lines.translation: You're the worst thing that has ever happened to me

annotations.body: 'Das Letzte' literally means 'the last thing,' but as an idiom it means something or someone is the absolute worst.

lines.original: Ja, es ist Raubbau an deinen Gefühlen mit rauen Worten
lines.translation: Yeah, I'm strip-mining your feelings with harsh words

annotations.body: 'Raubbau' is the ruthless, unsustainable exploitation of natural resources. The next line extends the metaphor by asking future partners to 'reforest' the emotional damage.

lines.original: Kommende Generationen von Partnern können das wieder aufforsten
lines.translation: Future generations of partners can reforest them

lines.original: Ich hau' berechnend auf den Tisch, das sind Faustformeln
lines.translation: I calculatedly bang my fist on the table - those are rules of thumb

annotations.originalPhrase: berechnend auf den Tisch, das sind Faustformeln
annotations.body: 'Berechnend' means calculating, while a 'Faustformel' is a rough formula or rule of thumb. 'Faust' also literally means fist, matching him banging on the table.

lines.original: Dass mein Körper checkt, dass wir dich aussortier'n, ah
lines.translation: So my body gets the message that we're sorting you out, ah

annotations.body: 'Aussortieren' means to reject or remove someone, but it also describes sorting waste into separate recycling categories.

lines.original: („Sei doch keine Drama-Queen“)
lines.translation: (‘Don't be such a drama queen’)

lines.original: Brülle ich mit kahlrasiertem Schädel aus dem Lamborghini und mein Mascara fließt
lines.translation: I yell from a Lamborghini with my head shaved bald and my mascara running

lines.original: Das ist der Ausstieg (Bye), au revoir, Paris
lines.translation: This is the withdrawal (bye), au revoir, Paris

annotations.body: The breakup 'exit' echoes withdrawal from the Paris Agreement on climate change. Donald Trump announced the United States' withdrawal in 2017, making it a prominent symbol of rejecting climate commitments.

lines.translation: Get out of my narrative

lines.translation: Yeah, I lay in your lap, sometimes laughing, sometimes crying

lines.original: Aber hast du dafür Zeugen? What?
lines.translation: But do you have any witnesses to that? What?

lines.original: Auf manchen Bildern frohlocke ich wie am Honigtopf
lines.translation: In some pictures I'm beaming like I've found the honey pot

lines.original: Doch nicht mehr lange, ich hab' Photoshop, ey
lines.translation: But not for much longer; I've got Photoshop, ey

lines.original: Du verschwindest, als würdest du das Regime kritisieren
lines.translation: You'll disappear as if you had criticized the regime

annotations.originalPhrase: als würdest du das Regime kritisieren
annotations.body: The narrator compares digitally erasing an ex-partner with authoritarian regimes making dissidents disappear and removing them from official records or photographs.

lines.original: Hast nie existiert, Geschichte wird von Siegern geschrieben
lines.translation: You never existed; history is written by the victors

lines.original: Wenn jemand fragt, leugne ich das Emotionsgewicht
lines.translation: If anyone asks, I'll deny the emotional weight

annotations.body: Denying the relationship's emotional significance is phrased like denying measurable environmental impact, echoing the language of climate-change denial.

lines.original: Du warst in meiner Vorgeschichte nur ein Vogelschiss (Mhh)
lines.translation: You were only a speck of bird shit in my history (Mmh)

annotations.body: This invokes a notorious 2018 statement by AfD politician Alexander Gauland, who called the Nazi era a mere 'speck of bird shit' in Germany's long history. The narrator uses the same revisionist minimization for his relationship.

lines.original: Da hängt von uns so ein romantisches Brückenschloss
lines.translation: There's one of those romantic love locks of ours hanging on a bridge

annotations.body: Couples attach engraved padlocks to bridges as symbols of lasting love, often throwing the key into the water. Keeping the key reveals that the narrator never fully committed to the symbolism.

lines.original: Doch Gott sei Dank hab' ich den Schlüssel noch
lines.translation: But thank God I still have the key

lines.original: Rücksichtslos, auch unser Baumherz küsst Diesel
lines.translation: Without looking back, even our tree-heart gets a kiss of diesel

annotations.body: 'Rücksichtslos' normally means inconsiderate or ruthless, but literally contains 'Rücksicht' - looking backward. The next line covers the rear-view mirror, making him literally unable to look back.
A heart carved into a tree is another romantic keepsake. Having it 'kiss diesel' combines destroying that memory with the song's deliberately polluting vehicle imagery.

lines.original: Socke übern Rückspiegel
lines.translation: A sock over the rear-view mirror

lines.translation: Love thy neighbor - yeah, I'm already loving the next ones

annotations.originalPhrase: Liebe deinen Nächsten, ja, ich liebe schon die Nächsten
annotations.body: 'Liebe deinen Nächsten' is the biblical commandment 'love thy neighbor.' Repeating 'die Nächsten' in the plural changes it to the next romantic partners in line.

lines.original: Dich liebe ich wie meinen Kieferorthopäden
lines.translation: I love you the way I love my orthodontist

lines.original: Guck, ich flieg' nach Indonesien, Lonesome Ride
lines.translation: Look, I'm flying to Indonesia, lonesome ride

lines.original: Ich hab' dich abgewählt, du warst meine Verbotspartei, oh
lines.translation: I voted you out; you were my nanny-state party, oh

annotations.body: 'Verbotspartei' literally means 'prohibition party' and is a political attack implying that a party wants to control everyday behavior. In German debate it is frequently directed at the Greens, especially over environmental rules.

lines.original: Du warst allergisch auf Fisch, hieltest mich ab vom Fisch
lines.translation: You were allergic to fish and kept me away from fish

lines.original: Heut ess' ich jeden Tag Fisch (Wouh) – ich hasse Fisch
lines.translation: Now I eat fish every day (Woo) - I hate fish

lines.original: Ich richte mich bergauf (Ah), ich bin nicht im Leerlauf (Nein)
lines.translation: I'm heading uphill (Ah); I'm not idling (No)

annotations.originalPhrase: bergauf (Ah), ich bin nicht im Leerlauf
annotations.body: 'Bergauf gehen' means that things are improving, while 'Leerlauf' can mean inactivity and an engine idling in neutral. The self-help claim remains inside the driving metaphor.

lines.original: Nein, ich leg' zuerst auf
lines.translation: No, I'm hanging up first

lines.original: Liebe ist alle, Liebe ist alle, Liebe ist alle, ey
lines.translation: Love is all gone, love is all gone, love is all gone, ey

annotations.body: In colloquial German, especially childlike speech, saying something 'ist alle' means it has all been used up or is gone. The phrase can misleadingly resemble the English declaration 'love is all.'
